status: frozen and committed before any score was computed in this cohort

question.asks: Does the already frozen lesion-associated programme increase in author-annotated type 2 cells in infected versus medium-matched mock explants from the same donor?
question.why_it_matters: Acute induction would challenge a broad reading of the programme as tumour-associated RNA. It would not show that infection and cancer share a mechanism, and it does not compare matched transitional states.
question.what_a_null_cannot_do: A negative or imprecise result cannot establish tumour specificity.
question.population_caveat: These tumour-free explants come from surgical cancer patients, so they are not a cancer-naive population.

cohort.object: GSE198864_lung_combined_all.rds, outer gzip layer stripped; see the C1 report
cohort.medium_source: the object's protocol field, which records BSA or FCS for every explant cell

secondary_modules: shared_remodelling, 10 genes, used only to form the beyond-shared contrast
inherited_unchanged_from_a11.normalization: edgeR DGEList, calcNormFactors TMM, cpm(log=TRUE, prior.count=1)
inherited_unchanged_from_a11.score: unweighted mean of the module's genes over the log CPM matrix
inherited_unchanged_from_a11.margin_rationale_inherited: a pragmatic planning margin based on a fraction of discovery, not clinically validated
inherited_unchanged_from_a11.cell_floor_origin: inherited from the A11 discovery primary configuration and not chosen for this cohort
inherited_unchanged_from_a11.why_inherited: a new assay may not retune the instrument that produced the result it is meant to challenge

state_definition.label: the object's author cluster label AT2
state_definition.why_author_annotation: the question asks about author-annotated type 2 cells, and a transferred label would introduce a second annotation decision this contract does not own
state_definition.alternative_present_but_not_used: predicted.id Alveolar Epithelial Type 2, a reference-transfer label, reported for context only

arm_eligibility_counted_before_any_score.rule: a donor contributes a pair when it supplies both the infected arm and a control in the same medium, each with at least the inherited 50-cell AT2 floor
arm_eligibility_counted_before_any_score.note: the donor lists above are the pairs whose smaller side clears 50 AT2 cells, read from the C1 design table; C3 recomputes them from the object and refuses to proceed on any disagreement

arm_selection.why: it is the only arm that clears the inherited 3-unit floor with any margin, at 4 eligible pairs. The floors were inherited rather than chosen here, so the selection rests on inherited criteria applied to counted coverage, not on any programme value.
arm_selection.secondary_predeclared: SARS-CoV-2, at 3 eligible pairs, exactly at the unit floor, reported beside the primary with no separate decision

declared_ineligible.MERS-CoV: 2 eligible pairs, below the inherited 3-unit floor
declared_ineligible.H3N2: 1 eligible pair, below the floor. The handoff nominated this arm for its acute-injury character; every influenza library is in BSA and only two donors have a BSA control, one of which has 19 AT2 cells on its infected side.

arm_selection.biological_cost_recorded: influenza and a coronavirus are different injuries with different tropism. Coverage cannot settle that, and the owner may reject this substitution; the register decision stays open until then.

tests.primary: exact paired location test of the per-donor difference in the lesion_specific score, infected minus medium-matched control, in the primary arm
secondary: beyond_shared, the lesion_specific difference minus the shared_remodelling difference
the secondary arm repeated for all three
tests.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the secondary tests only, as the A11 instrument does; the primary carries the decision
tests.direction_predicted: positive, an increase in the infected arm, declared before any score

power_declared_in_advance.consequence: the primary cannot reject at alpha 0.05 at these unit counts. That is known before running and is not a reason to change the test.
power_declared_in_advance.what_the_decision_rests_on: the Hodges-Lehmann estimate and its exact interval against the inherited 0.10 margin, plus the direction count across donors
power_declared_in_advance.if_the_exact_interval_is_unavailable: the A11 helper reports it as unavailable and that is the result, not a prompt to substitute an approximate test

decision_rules.acute_induction_supported: the exact interval lies entirely above the 0.10 margin and every eligible donor moves in the predicted direction
decision_rules.margin_ruled_out: the exact interval upper bound lies below 0.10, which bounds acute induction as smaller than the planning margin in this assay
decision_rules.unresolved: any other outcome, including an unavailable exact interval, which is the expected outcome at these unit counts

prohibited: treating cells, libraries or organoids as replicates
pooling BSA and FCS controls, or pairing across media
substituting a sensitivity arm, a different state label or an approximate test to reach a threshold
deriving any gene list from this cohort
reading the autopsy compartment into this contrast
adding or grading a claim row
gates_c3_must_apply_before_scoring: gene coverage of the 73-gene module in the object's RNA index at or above 0.7
recomputation of the eligible pair list, refusing on any disagreement with the counts above
confirmation that the RNA assay holds raw integer counts, already checked in C1
